observations: Single photo shows a stainless-steel/silver countertop microwave with a black glass door.
Control panel has mechanical dial knobs (one for power/function, one for timer), not a digital display.
Microwave is placed on top of another appliance (possibly a gas cylinder or water dispenser) in what looks like a shop display.
Store watermark text overlays the image ('...TON NIG', 'THE HOUSEHOLD STYLING') - not a product brand.
No readable brand or model text visible on the unit itself.
No interior tray, cord, or rear panel visible; no close-up of control panel or nameplate.

claims.evidence: No serial, import sticker, or plug type visible to confirm origin.
No power-on photo, no video of it heating or timer running; single static shop photo only.

risks.risk: Heating function may not actually work (magnetron failure is common in used microwaves).
risks.proof: Short video of it running with a cup of water visibly heating/steaming, or turntable spinning.

risks.risk: Missing glass turntable tray or roller ring.
risks.proof: Photo of open interior showing tray and ring in place.

risks.risk: Door seal/latch damage or hinge wear (common in tokunbo units), which is a safety issue.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of door seal and latch mechanism, and of door closing fully.

risks.risk: Power cord/plug condition and type unknown (may need adapter or have frayed wiring).
risks.proof: Photo of plug and cord length.

risks.risk: Interior rust, burn marks, or odor from prior use.
risks.proof: Clear photo of interior cavity walls and floor.

risks.risk: Unknown wattage/capacity, which affects comparables and price tier.
risks.proof: Photo of nameplate/rating label (usually inside door frame or on back).
risks.if_unproven: priced at lowest common wattage tier for this size/style

proof_requests: Video of microwave running with a cup of water showing it heats and turntable rotates.
Photo of the interior cavity (tray, ring, walls).
Close-up of the nameplate/rating label for brand, model, and wattage.
Photo of the power cord and plug.
Close-up of the door seal and latch while closed and open.
response.reason: The item is clearly a standard dial-type countertop microwave, identifiable by type even without a brand/model, so it can be priced at worst case (assume non-functional heating and no verified completeness) pending the listed proofs.
